user.title: eNet bridge
user.description: Where does the installation come from?

menu_options.export: Take over from an eNet Server export (.iex)

export.title: Take over eNet Server
export.description: Export the project in the eNet Server (or app) and upload the .iex file. Domain, server identity, devices and scenes are taken over; nothing has to be reprogrammed.

data.server_aus: The eNet Server is switched off

data_description.server_aus: While the real server is running: leave unchecked. The bridge then only listens (keys, lamp states), sends and programs nothing. Once the server is off, turn off "Listen only" on the bridge.

neu.title: New installation
neu.description: The bridge becomes the server of a new eNet installation (own domain and server identity). Devices are added later by teaching them in.

datei.title: Installation file
datei.description: Serial port of the bridge and path to the installation file (anlage.json from tools/iex.py). It is imported once; afterwards Home Assistant keeps the installation.

reconfigure.title: Bridge port
reconfigure.description: Choose the serial port of the eNet bridge. Radios of other integrations (Thread/Zigbee/Z-Wave) are not offered.

error.export_invalid: Not a valid eNet Server export
error.export_encrypted: Encrypted installations are not supported – switch off encryption in the eNet Server first
error.port_fremd: This is the radio of another integration (Thread/Zigbee/Z-Wave) – please choose the bridge port

abort.already_configured: This installation is already set up
abort.port_in_use: This bridge port is already used by another eNet installation

release.name: Release bridge
release.description: Closes the serial port, e.g. for flashing firmware.

szene_anlegen.name: Create eNet scene
szene_anlegen.description: Creates a KNX scene in the actuators (links for scene call and summary status). With 'learn', the current state of the lights becomes the scene values.

lernen.name: Learn
lernen.description: Store the current state as scene values

szene_loeschen.name: Delete eNet scene
szene_loeschen.description: Removes the scene links from all members and deletes the scene.

geraet_einlernen.name: Teach in device
geraet_einlernen.description: Searches for an eNet device in learning mode (press the button on the device), takes it into the installation and calibrates the radio if necessary.

geraet_entfernen.name: Remove device
geraet_entfernen.description: Resets an eNet device to factory state and removes it from the installation.

sender_programmieren.name: Program sender
sender_programmieren.description: Wakes a hand-held or wall sender (press a key on it) and rewrites its complete configuration from the installation: mode of each rocker, rocker → actuators, single key → server key.

verknuepfungen_lesen.name: Read links
verknuepfungen_lesen.description: Reads the link tables of actuators (all, if none is selected) and rates every entry: factory entry, scene, rocker, other device, old link or foreign device. Old and foreign links are reported under Repairs. Only reads, changes nothing.

user.title: Add eNet device
user.description: Optionally enter a name and an area. After clicking Submit, put the device into learning mode (mini actuators: hold the button for 4 s; senders: learning button or key combination). The search runs for 2 minutes; a sender is programmed right away and its learning LED stops blinking.

progress.suchen: Searching – put the device into learning mode now. Teaching in and programming take up to 2 minutes.

abort.nicht_geladen: The eNet installation is not loaded (bridge connected?).

entfernen.title: Remove device
entfernen.description: Which device should be removed from the installation? It is reset to factory state.

bestaetigen.title: Remove {name}?

sender.title: Configure sender
sender.description: Which hand-held or wall sender should be configured?

betriebsart.title: {name}: rockers
betriebsart.description:
Mode per rocker (rocker 1 = keys 1/2, rocker 2 = keys 3/4 …).

- **Rocker**: switches/dims the selected lamps directly, feedback from the lamps.
- **Single keys**: each key reports to the bridge (green LED) and triggers an eNet scene, a bridge scene or just an event for Home Assistant automations.

details.title: {name}: assignment
details.description: Lamps of the rockers or action of each single key. If mode or lamps change, the sender is programmed afterwards (press a key on it); a changed action only needs the bridge. Home Assistant lamps (other integrations) are switched and dimmed by Home Assistant; the bridge acknowledges the rocker (green LED, only while no eNet Server is running).

progress.laeuft: Removing device … (for a sender, press a key on it now)
progress.programmieren: Programming sender … press a key on it now (wake up) and keep it nearby for about a minute.

abort.entfernt_offen: {name} has been removed from the installation. Open: {offen}
abort.nicht_geladen: The eNet installation is not loaded (bridge connected?).
abort.keine_sender: There is no sender in the installation.

geraet_loeschen.message: Please remove eNet devices via “Configure → Remove device” on the eNet installation – the device is reset there and everything related is cleaned up.

antwortet_nicht.title: eNet: {name} does not respond
antwortet_nicht.description: {name} ({ia}, serial {sn}) is part of the installation but does not respond. Possible causes: no power, out of radio range, removed or replaced (a new device has a different serial number and must be paired again).

entfernen.title: Remove {name}
entfernen.description: {name} is removed from the installation including entities, scene memberships and sender references. If the device is still present it is reset to factory state.

szenen_mithoeren.title: eNet: scenes are converted after listen-only mode
szenen_mithoeren.description: These eNet scenes cannot be edited yet: {szenen}. To turn them into Home Assistant scenes, the scene values must be read from the actuators, and the bridge sends nothing while "Listen only" is on. Switch off the real eNet Server, then switch off "Listen only" on the bridge; the scenes are converted automatically.

szenen_nicht_umgewandelt.title: eNet: scenes not converted yet
szenen_nicht_umgewandelt.description: These eNet scenes are not Home Assistant scenes yet because not all scene values could be read from the actuators: {szenen}. Conversion is retried on every start.

szenen_links_fehlen.title: eNet: scene links missing
szenen_links_fehlen.description: {kanaele} lack links for the scenes {szenen}. These lamps do not react to the eNet scene call (Home Assistant switches them individually instead).

init.title: Create scene links
init.description: The missing links are written to the actuators. The actuators restart briefly; lamps that were on are switched on again afterwards.

unbekannter_sender.title: eNet: unknown sender ({sn})
unbekannter_sender.description: A sender with serial {sn} presses keys but is not part of the installation. Add it: Settings → Devices & services → eNet → "Add device".

szene_wird_uebertragen.title: eNet: scene {szene} is being transferred – please wait
szene_wird_uebertragen.description: The eNet part of the scene {szene} is being written to the actuators. Until this is finished the scene runs lamp by lamp via Home Assistant. This notice disappears by itself.

aktor_wird_programmiert.title: eNet: programming {geraete} – please wait
aktor_wird_programmiert.description: {geraete} is being programmed by radio. Its lamps briefly go off and are restored afterwards. This notice disappears by itself.

links_auffaellig.title: eNet: {name} has unexpected links

entfernen.title: Remove links from {name}
entfernen.description: The table is read again and the listed entries are deleted from the actuator. The actuator restarts briefly; a lamp that was on is switched on again afterwards. Only remove them if no transmitter outside this installation still uses them.

behalten.title: Keep links in {name}
behalten.description: The entries stay in the actuator and are no longer reported. New unexpected entries are still reported.

options.tasten: Two single buttons (server buttons, green LED)
